description:
[Game reference] Top speed of a horse for a breed and its gear, on or off road. The game's formula (RidableHorse.GetCurrentMaxSpeed): at a gallop, `(14 + road bonus + every gear speed change + boost)
x breed speed multiplier`. Returns `gallop_kmh`/`gallop_ms`, every gait's top speed, the extra `storage_slots` and
`stamina_seconds_full` (how long a full 60 stamina gallops). 422 for an unknown breed/item or more than 4 gear items. Gear and boosts are added before the breed multiplier. km/h = m/s x 3.6. Vanilla values. Link https://rust.wiki/horses#calculator.

road.description: Galloping on a road or railway (+1 m/s, half the stamina use).

saddlebags.description: How many saddlebags (each -1 m/s, +12 storage slots).

towing.description: Also return the speed limit while towing a siege weapon.

name: calculate_horse_speed
title: Top speed of a horse for a breed and its gear, on or off road
